about: Engine 94 train (coordinator ruling 2026-11-22): what MemberPane's Add may send, and whether it may send it now, is ONE authority (addAuthority.js) read by the render and both handlers (ITEM 2's keep-or-refuse and the paste worker's wait were each written twice and could not be mutation-proved); a build minted on a pending admission is never kept another way (reachability); the queued Add sends what the authority keeps. Every rule, broken once, must turn its rail red.
